name: the-text-shaper-is-named-not-inherited
breaks: which renderer draws Dan's type goes back to being decided by whatever Pillow build happens to be installed. Measured 2026-08-17: the same Pillow version renders the before/after title band about four pixels across depending on whether raqm is present, which is 0.64% of the frame and enough to fail its reference, so rebuilding a virtualenv could change what his graphics look like (#656). The guard points at the argument being passed rather than the resulting engine, because the behavioural assertion is vacuous on any machine without raqm, which is every CI runner: it SURVIVED there on 2026-08-17
